purpose.summary: An online CICS mortgage-calculation program that presents a BMS map (EPMENU/EPSMORT) to accept loan principal, term in years, and interest rate from the user, then calls a subprogram (EPSCSMRT) to compute the monthly payment. It also performs a dummy DB2 SQL SELECT against SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 on each invocation, likely to verify database connectivity.
